label: One sound two-world explanation model has local no-brute existence coverage at…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Some sound Model Bool Bool has local explanation coverage at false, an unexplained actual existence fact at true, and fails all-world existence-PSR. The optional actual-world position therefore must not be replaced by the all-world existence-PSR. Explanation adequacy and metaphysical possibility are not certified.
